summary.text: Rudolph Drake is the Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican John Roberts.
A U.S. Navy veteran and former Department of Defense police officer, he won the Democratic primary runoff on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rudolph Drake was born in Huntsville, Alabama, and served in the United States Navy in aviation quality assurance.
His career experience includes working as a Department of Defense police officer and in aviation leadership supporting aircraft operations.
Drake finished first in the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary and defeated Alex House in the June 16, 2026 runoff, 53.5% to 46.5%.
